description: The webviews of the PDF export print windows (labels print-*; each window has one webview with its label), only on the app's own pages (local: true, no remote URLs). They render one document with the answer renderer. App commands: the print-window permission (permissions/print-window.json), their job and ready report and the paper-figure reads. Plugins: listen/unlisten only (the renderer follows settings events). No file system, dialog, opener, clipboard or window-management permissions. Not granted: the notification plugin's permission query, which its page script makes on macOS at load; it fails with a console error and changes nothing.
